verdict.rationale: The pack shows AI-adjacent building blocks: an llms.txt with instructions for AI agents, markdown versions of doc pages, an OpenAPI spec, and an MCP server hosted under the docs domain. None of these documents Mangopay itself letting users operate payments, wallets or payouts through natural-language commands. The MCP server's scope is undocumented, and its docs-hosted path suggests documentation access rather than product operation, so these count only as developer building blocks rather than the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
